rules.action: Deploy distal stent first, work proximally. Post-dilate each segment with NC balloon before deploying the next.
rules.rationale: Proximal-first deployment obstructs the distal vessel for the remainder of the procedure. Sequential distal-to-proximal deployment and post-dilatation prevents geographic miss and stent underexpansion.
rules.detail: Plan overlap zones carefully — overlap should be ≥3mm and avoid placing overlaps in side branches.

rules.action: Ultra-thin strut DES preferred for bifurcation PCI.
rules.rationale: Ultra-thin struts facilitate SB rewiring through stent cells and reduce jailing effect.
rules.detail: Size stent to distal MV reference diameter for provisional strategy (Murray's law).

rules.action: Size stent to distal MV reference (Murray's law) for bifurcation cases; use proximal reference for shaft/ostial disease.
rules.rationale: Proximal LM is larger than the distal reference — sizing to the distal vessel avoids overexpansion proximally.
rules.detail: Proximal stent edge must not protrude into the aorta. Post-dilate with NC balloon sized to proximal LM to ensure full expansion at the largest segment. Confirm MSA with IVUS before completing.

rules.action: BMS and DES are equally effective in SVG intervention. Use slightly undersized stent diameter with generous length to minimise plaque extrusion.
rules.rationale: SVG PCI has high ischaemic event rates regardless of stent type — minimise stent trauma.
rules.detail: Individualise stent choice based on lesion diameter, long-term DAPT tolerance, and patient adherence. Consider prolonged DAPT based on the DAPT score.

rules.action: Target complete revascularisation where feasible; stage if haemodynamic reserve is limited.
rules.rationale: Residual ischaemia with impaired LV function is associated with worse long-term outcomes.
rules.detail: Staged complete revascularisation is preferable to complex multivessel PCI in a single session when haemodynamic reserve is limited. Minimise stent length per vessel to reduce ischaemic time.

rules.action: IVUS mandatory. Confirm optimal result — stent sizing and expansion are critical. Discuss bailout strategy with the team before starting.
rules.rationale: A poorly expanded or failed stent in the only remaining coronary is catastrophic — there is no haemodynamic reserve to tolerate an inadequate result.
rules.detail: Accept a longer procedure time to ensure the optimal result.
rules.caution: Discuss abrupt closure bailout with the team and theatre before the procedure begins.
